title: ROSALIA the Video Game
subtitle: Tribute video game UI design
description:
"Rosalía: The Videogame" is a music platform adventure that takes players into the universe of the artist Rosalía, with scenarios inspired by her songs and albums, especially El Mal Querer, and rhythmic challenges that reflect her fusion of flamenco and urban style.

I made the project for a university course of UI design, with which I obtained an honors degree.

I designed the user interface (UI) and the art of scenarios and characters of the video game. For this I made a complete study and design process that included the development of the briefing, the persona profile, the benchmarking, the creation of the moodboard, the development of wireframes and mock-ups, and finally the style bible.
